Res.FullDescription: Please enter or click to select a creditor where applicable. This field is applicable when you enter an Actual Cost or want to indicate the expected Creditor for the estimated Cost or Accrual.

Res.FullDescription: Please enter or click to select a debtor where this charge is to be billed to

Res.FullDescription: Please enter the cost amount in the nominated cost currency.

Res.FullDescription: Please enter the sell amount in the nominated sell currency.

Res.FullDescription: System calculated based on the Tax Percentage of the Withholding Tax ID against the Overseas Sell Amount.

Res.Caption: WHT Amount
Res.FullDescription: System calculated based on the Tax Percentage of the Withholding Tax ID against the Overseas Cost Amount.
